# FTXUI

> C++ Functional Terminal User Interface library (v7.x). Zero dependencies, cross-platform (Linux, macOS, Windows, WebAssembly).

## Important API Notes (v7+)
- Use `ftxui::App` (from `<ftxui/component/app.hpp>`), NOT the deprecated `ScreenInteractive`.
- Use `ftxui::Cell` / `ftxui::Surface` / `CellAt()`, NOT the deprecated `Pixel` / `Image` / `PixelAt()`.
- Always pass a `Container` as the first argument to `Renderer(container, [&] { ... })` so events and focus reach child components.
- Use `App::Post(...)` + `App::RequestAnimationFrame()` for thread-safe updates from background threads.

- [Components (ftxui/component)](/api/component): Button, CatchEvent, Checkbox, ComponentBase::Active, ComponentBase::ActiveChild, ComponentBase::Add, ComponentBase::CaptureMouse, ComponentBase::ChildAt, ComponentBase::ChildCount, ComponentBase::Detach, ComponentBase::DetachAllChildren, ComponentBase::Focusable, ComponentBase::Focused, ComponentBase::OnAnimation, ComponentBase::OnEvent, ComponentBase::Parent, ComponentBase::Render, ComponentBase::SetActiveChild, ComponentBase::TakeFocus, Container::Horizontal, Container::Tab, Container::Vertical, Hoverable, Input, Maybe, Menu, MenuEntry, Radiobox, Renderer, ResizableSplit, ResizableSplitBottom, ResizableSplitLeft, ResizableSplitRight, ResizableSplitTop, Slider, Toggle
